mission: Generate money ASAP: land first Murshed client (OMR 50/mo), launch Gumroad + Fiverr passive income, onboard with oman-lead-bot. Agent runs every task it can; human only signs in, bills, and approves.

tracks.name: Track 0 — System Health (know what you have)

steps.title: Verify oman-lead-bot deployment health (env vars, site, webhook)
Extract Murshed system prompt, objection scripts, contract from the blueprint

tracks.name: Track A — Direct Sales (Murshed → Real Estate)  [OMR 50/mo first client]

steps.title: Research fresh leads via OpenRouter (real estate + hospitality + retail in Oman)
Send outreach (test number first: +968 7254 2766)
steps.instructions: Run: python3 ~/Life/murshed_bot.py — opens WhatsApp Web pre-filled. Click Send, press Enter. Test number first, then verified leads.

steps.title: Reply to responses with demo script (2-min rule)
steps.instructions: Copy Demo Reply from ~/Life/agents/assets/outreach/pack.md within 2 minutes of each reply.

steps.title: Book + run demo calls (15 min, close OMR 50/mo)
steps.instructions: Call script in ~/Life/agents/assets/outreach/pack.md. Close: '50 ريال شهريًا — أقل من موظف استقبال ليوم واحد'

steps.title: Collect payment (thawani / bank transfer)
steps.instructions: Send thawani link or bank details. Send payment-confirmation message from the pack.

steps.title: Generate client onboarding brief for the paying client

tracks.name: Track B — Gumroad (Arabic AI Prompt Kit, $19)  [passive international]

steps.title: Generate/refresh the Arabic AI Prompt Kit (50 prompts, PDF)
Upload the product ($19)
steps.instructions: Gumroad → New Product. Name: 'Arabic AI Business Prompt Kit'. Upload assets/gumroad/arabic-ai-prompt-kit.pdf. Paste product-copy.md. Price $19.

tracks.name: Track C — Fiverr (Arabic AI Chatbot Gig, $50-200)  [GCC services demand]

steps.title: Generate/refresh Fiverr gig package + cover image
Create Fiverr account
steps.instructions: Open https://fiverr.com/join — real name, bio from assets/fiverr/gig-package.md

steps.title: Publish the gig ($50/$100/$200)
steps.instructions: Paste title/desc/tags from assets/fiverr/gig-package.md. Upload gig-cover.png.

tracks.name: Track D — The Product Engine (oman-lead-bot → clients)

steps.title: Paste WHATSAPP_TOKEN + WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID into oman-lead-bot Settings → Keys
steps.instructions: Meta dashboard → System users → generate permanent token; copy Phone number ID from API Setup. Also set WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN and point webhook at <site-url>/whatsapp-webhook.

steps.title: Generate the Murshed product demo script (for client calls)

gates_summary: Agent runs all auto tasks. Human gates: send outreach, signup Gumroad/Fiverr, upload products, paste Meta keys, collect payment.
